exercises.positivePrompt: Replace this application's shell and navigation with a proven project-management product structure.
exercises.negativePrompt: Repair the focus ring on the existing navigation button without changing the shell.
exercises.changedDecision: Pin compatible licensed source and preserve its product topology before making the requested adaptation.
exercises.observation: A source receipt, license, materialized files, and a mapping from the adopted topology to the requested product roles.
exercises.gracePath: Report that no compatible licensed source was found and stop before inventing a replacement topology.

exercises.positivePrompt: Animate this React list so insertion, removal, and reordered state remain understandable.
exercises.negativePrompt: Change the static label text in this React list.
exercises.changedDecision: Choose motion from the state transition and provide a static reduced-motion result.
exercises.observation: The implemented transition, reduced-motion behavior, and a focused state-change check or authorized rendered review.
exercises.gracePath: Keep the interface static and report the missing motion or rendered observer.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $design-accessible-interfaces to implement this keyboard-operated combobox.
exercises.negativePrompt: Rename a non-interactive paragraph in the existing page.
exercises.changedDecision: Use an established accessible component or the correct native semantics and interaction contract.
exercises.observation: Keyboard, focus, name, role, state, and announcement behavior checked in the authorized environment.
exercises.gracePath: Report the unverified assistive-technology behavior and retain the established component semantics.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $design-color-systems to define the semantic colors for this new web theme.
exercises.negativePrompt: Change one approved icon without altering any theme color.
exercises.changedDecision: Derive semantic roles and state pairs from the existing palette and contrast requirements instead of choosing isolated colors.
exercises.observation: Color tokens, role mappings, gamut treatment, and contrast results for the required states.
exercises.gracePath: Preserve the established palette and report the role or contrast conflict that needs a design decision.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $design-interface-details to draw and align the approved empty-state SVG icon.
exercises.negativePrompt: Decide what navigation and content this empty state should contain.
exercises.changedDecision: Implement the settled asset role without changing product structure or inventing meaning.
exercises.observation: The code-native asset, optical alignment, state behavior, and reduced-motion result when motion is present.
exercises.gracePath: Report the unsettled product role and return it to the frontend design owner before drawing the asset.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $design-web-typography to define the responsive type roles for this interface.
exercises.negativePrompt: Fix an API retry bug that does not affect rendered text.
exercises.changedDecision: Use the established font and token system to define resilient roles, spacing, wrapping, and accessibility behavior.
exercises.observation: Type roles and tokens checked across the required content, zoom, and responsive states.
exercises.gracePath: Preserve the existing type system and report the missing font, token, or rendered observer.

exercises.positivePrompt: Design a novel interaction for comparing two live deployment states before implementing it.
exercises.negativePrompt: Fix the established deployment table's horizontal overflow without changing its interaction.
exercises.changedDecision: Materialize and compare a genuinely different representation, preserve the visual evidence that defines the decision, and complete only the approved frontend stage.
exercises.observation: A design-search record, durable visual evidence, one approved answer, and a stage contract with an explicit promotion gate.
exercises.gracePath: Report the missing product evidence or decision owner and stop before inventing visible structure.

exercises.positivePrompt: Repair this settled interface so its layout and overflow work in narrow and wide containers.
exercises.negativePrompt: Decide whether this product should use a feed or a dashboard.
exercises.changedDecision: Express container and layout relationships in the owning stylesheet without changing product meaning.
exercises.observation: Focused CSS ownership, overflow, interaction-state, and container behavior in the authorized review environment.
exercises.gracePath: Report the unverified container or rendered state and preserve the approved composition.

exercises.positivePrompt: Restructure this Tailwind CSS v4 component so container behavior and variants have one owner.
exercises.negativePrompt: Write responsive CSS for a project that does not use Tailwind.
exercises.changedDecision: Use the installed Tailwind v4 conventions and project theme rather than introducing a parallel styling approach.
exercises.observation: Tailwind configuration, class ownership, variants, responsive behavior, and focused checks.
exercises.gracePath: Route to the plain responsive CSS owner or report the missing Tailwind configuration.

exercises.positivePrompt: Measure this repository's package and file shape so we can compare it with the previous release.
exercises.negativePrompt: Explain one known function whose exact path is already supplied.
exercises.changedDecision: Run the deterministic inventory and report its JSON facts rather than estimating repository shape.
exercises.observation: Validated inventory JSON with the selected report mode and comparison baseline.
exercises.gracePath: Report the unsupported repository input or missing runtime without inventing counts.

exercises.positivePrompt: Redesign this persisted TypeScript job state so contradictory completion fields cannot coexist.
exercises.negativePrompt: Rename a local TypeScript variable without changing its type or boundary.
exercises.changedDecision: Model valid states first, derive authoritative shapes, validate external data, and strengthen types only where partial operations require it.
exercises.observation: Representative valid and invalid states, boundary conversion, public call-site pressure, and focused invariant checks.
exercises.gracePath: Preserve the established type convention and report the unresolved domain term, schema owner, or unavailable invariant check.

exercises.positivePrompt: This regression has several plausible causes and targeted inspection did not establish which one is real.
exercises.negativePrompt: Fix the misspelled constant whose failing line and correction are already known.
exercises.changedDecision: Reproduce, rank plausible causes, run separating probes, and fix only the proved cause.
exercises.observation: A reproduced failure, probe results, proved cause, focused regression check, and cleanup of instrumentation.
exercises.gracePath: Report the missing reproducer or observer and stop before selecting a speculative cause.

exercises.positivePrompt: Implement a substantial parser for a public protocol that may already have a maintained library.
exercises.negativePrompt: Add a two-line project-specific mapping with no reusable mechanism.
exercises.changedDecision: Search project code, maintained packages, and compatible licensed source before writing the mechanism.
exercises.observation: A reuse assessment naming source, revision, license, fit, costs, and the chosen adoption or justified gap.
exercises.gracePath: Implement the project-specific gap independently and report why available reuse was incompatible or unlicensed.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $write-technical-prose to clear the deterministic prose findings in this technical guide.
exercises.negativePrompt: Draft a conversational product announcement with no repository prose check.
exercises.changedDecision: Repair only the reported technical-prose findings while preserving the document's facts and role.
exercises.observation: The repository-declared technical-prose check passes on the selected documentation.
exercises.gracePath: Report the unavailable check or disputed finding without claiming compliance.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use $writing-great-skills to create an automatically selected skill for database migration reviews.
exercises.negativePrompt: Write ordinary project documentation that is not an agent skill.
exercises.changedDecision: Give the skill one discriminating trigger, one owner, progressive detail, and observable completion without repeating global policy.
exercises.observation: Structural skill validation, agent-prose results, invocation metadata, and a representative forward-use outcome.
exercises.gracePath: Keep the skill explicit or stop publication when the trigger, observer, or authority remains unsettled.

exercises.positivePrompt: Change Agent Context Framework governance and carry the decision through its registry projections.
exercises.negativePrompt: Implement an ordinary application feature without changing framework policy.
exercises.changedDecision: Map retained and changed behavior, assign owners, split prose from enforcement, and propagate the canonical edit.
exercises.observation: A semantic preservation map, governance and registry agreement, focused checks, and reported grace paths.
exercises.gracePath: Stop at the unresolved owner or conflicting retained requirement and request the missing decision.

exercises.positivePrompt: Review this completed Codex task and exact Git range for repeated repair and misplaced context.
exercises.negativePrompt: Judge an active task that has not reached a delivery boundary.
exercises.changedDecision: Use measured session and Git evidence to separate necessary work, quality work, and avoidable churn.
exercises.observation: Measured task evidence, observed and inferred claims, bounded recommendations, and a comparison for later tasks.
exercises.gracePath: Report unavailable session or range evidence and do not turn an incomplete task into a final workflow verdict.

exercises.positivePrompt: Build a resumable Codex SDK workflow with stored evidence, finite repair rounds, and enforced permissions.
exercises.negativePrompt: Use one ordinary plan for a short serial edit that returns in this task.
exercises.changedDecision: Choose one bounded workflow helper and encode stages, permissions, evidence, return paths, and stopping conditions in project code.
exercises.observation: Typed workflow state, ledger evidence, mock tests, bounded counters, and task acceptance checks.
exercises.gracePath: Use a native subagent or ordinary plan when durability is unnecessary, or report the unsupported workflow shape.

exercises.positivePrompt: Add a persistent background job that retries failed network delivery and reports its terminal outcome.
exercises.negativePrompt: Refactor the pure function that calculates retry delays but performs no delivery, persistence, process, or reporting work.
exercises.changedDecision: Define expected and exceptional failures, applicable timeout and cancellation behavior, retry safety, cleanup, one reporting owner, and safe event context.
exercises.observation: A boundary contract and focused failure-path, retry, cleanup, and reporting evidence.
exercises.gracePath: Preserve error context and report the missing logger, telemetry backend, runtime observer, or authority without installing infrastructure.

exercises.positivePrompt: Two concurrent workers update different fields in the same persisted state object.
exercises.negativePrompt: One synchronous function mutates a local object that no other actor can access.
exercises.changedDecision: Give independent facts separate write targets before considering a transaction, lock, compare-and-swap, or single writer.
exercises.observation: An ownership map and a focused concurrency check or proof of the repository's atomic single-writer mechanism.
exercises.gracePath: Report the exact unsafe target and missing concurrency mechanism or architecture decision.

exercises.positivePrompt: Refactor this six-layer call path where three wrappers forward the same arguments and hidden module state changes the result.
exercises.negativePrompt: Add a required validation boundary that hides a real external format change.
exercises.changedDecision: Remove layers that own no decision, shrink mutable state scope, and retain boundaries that own a named guarantee.
exercises.observation: The before-and-after call path, state owner, retained boundary decisions, and focused behavior checks.
exercises.gracePath: Retain the public or authority boundary and report the remaining trace cost when cleanup is outside scope.

exercises.positivePrompt: Use the GitHub connector to implement this feature without changing my local checkout.
exercises.negativePrompt: Explain this local diff without changing files, branches, or pull requests.
exercises.changedDecision: Pin development, create one remote task branch, commit bounded slices with Git objects, and open a draft pull request to development.
exercises.observation: The exact baseline and head commits, non-forced branch updates, a draft pull request, commit-bound verification, and an unchanged local checkout.
exercises.gracePath: Leave the last safe remote state intact and report the missing connector operation, authority, or conflicting branch head.
